decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform, and its rapid release cycle shows active learning and strong related knowledge to keep improving it.
The hierarchical search bundle builds directly on existing map.apps search know-how, though its low website visibility suggests it may later be folded into broader search features.
The mobile layer control rests on the firm's map UI expertise and addresses a real usability gap, but as an experimental component it carries some risk of being absorbed or replaced.
The GIS solution platform is the core of the firm's accumulated knowledge base and the foundation for its other products, so dropping it is very unlikely.
Field data capture fits the firm's GIS integration competence and has its own page, though competing vendor apps create some pressure.
The search extension leverages the firm's deep experience with spatial search in web map apps and is prominently presented, so it is easy to interpret and improve.
